TextView.android:text: Balanced mobile defaults: 48MiB Go cap, 512 clients, 16KB HEV stack.
Caps concurrent SOCKS5 sockets. Lower saves RAM; higher helps heavy multitasking.
MASQUE HTTP/2 ping interval. Longer intervals let the cellular radio sleep for better battery.
Idle TCP probe interval. Higher reduces wakeups; lower keeps NAT bindings alive.
How fast half-closed TCP streams are reaped to free RAM and socket slots.
Soft Go heap ceiling when Psiphon is active. Prevents Android LMK kills.
Caps Go scheduler OS threads. 1–2 reduces heat and battery drain; 4 boosts throughput.
Lower (25) frees RAM aggressively; higher (100) reduces GC CPU spikes.
1280 avoids fragmentation on LTE/5G; 1400–1420 improves Wi-Fi bulk throughput.
Per-session HEV stack size. 16KB minimizes RAM; 24KB–32KB adds headroom for heavy media.
5s reclaims dropped QUIC/UDP probes quickly; 15s–30s helps long-lived UDP games/calls.
Intercepts DNS locally inside HEV for faster lookups and zero DNS leaks (auto-disabled if Custom DNS or Iran Direct is active).
Noize packet padding/shaping. Off gives best battery and speed; Light/Balanced helps bypass DPI.
Endpoint discovery depth. Turbo connects fastest with lowest battery; Thorough/Ironclad probe more IPs.
Transport used when Psiphon chaining is enabled. Auto selects the fastest reachable tunnel.
